lessons.title: Earth turns
lessons.goal: Explain why stars appear to move during the night.

lessons.title: A changing Moon
lessons.goal: Recognize that the Moon reflects sunlight.

example_slides.html:
Earth turns

Our view of the stars changes as Earth rotates.
example_slides.narration: Earth rotates. Stars appear to move across the sky as our view changes.

example_slides.html:
A changing Moon

The Moon reflects sunlight. Its visible sunlit shape changes as it orbits Earth.
example_slides.narration: The Moon reflects sunlight. We see different portions of its sunlit half as it orbits Earth.
